scope: Quality and accuracy of a completed read-only CAD audit; not acceptance of the PCB for manufacture

open_board_findings.finding: Nine copper clearances 0.45-0.73 mm violate the 0.75 mm rule.
The local copper-pour keepout no longer covers the required C11.1 to U1.3 input segment.
The decoupling supply path through the top jumper is long; shorten the actual supply/ground loop in the next design step.
Five modified footprints require physical part verification and matching local library updates; do not overwrite user geometry blindly.
Zone settings permit narrower copper than the prior LUT target; select the manufacturing minimum and recheck after changes.
Default/LUT netclasses still omit schematic widths/style; existing explicit-width wires avoid the previously investigated path.

limitations: No PCB, schematic, original archive, firmware or application changes in this audit.
No new native GUI persistence cycle; user-reported ERC success is not claimed as an automated check.
No physical fit, soldering, noise, stability, protection, calibration, etching or automotive validation.
The former S1 harness-length and separation requirements still require verification on the actual assembly.
PASS of the audit does not resolve the listed PCB defects or authorize fabrication.
